basic_details.job_title: SDAU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 3 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow: B. Sc. (Agri.) / B. Sc. (Horti.)

vacancy_details.Name of the Projects: Evaluation of oxathiapiprolin 3% + mandipropamid 25% w/v against pomegranate fruit rots
Efficacy evaluation of fluopyram 250g/L + trifloxystrobin 250g/L SC on rose crop
Efficacy evaluation of 'UPI 2377-002' against insect pests of chilli

post_wise_breakdown.name_of_the_projects: Evaluation of oxathiapiprolin 3% + mandipropamid 25% w/v against pomegranate fruit rots
Efficacy evaluation of fluopyram 250g/L + trifloxystrobin 250g/L SC on rose crop
Efficacy evaluation of 'UPI 2377-002' against insect pests of chilli

salary_details.details: The position is contractual and fixed-pay for 11 months or up to completion of project work, whichever is early.

how_to_apply: Visit the official university website at www.sdau.edu.in to download the Application Proforma.
Fill out the Application Proforma completely with all required details.
Gather original and certified copies of educational qualifications, work experience, publications, awards, and age proof.
Remain present at the place of walk-in interview at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time on the specified date.
Attend the interview at the College of Horticulture, S. D. Agricultural University, Jagudan-384 460 (Dist. Mehsana) at your own cost.
important_instructions: The post is purely on a temporary basis and will be automatically terminated on completion of 11 months or project work, whichever is early. The university provides no employment after the completion of the period. Services can be terminated without prior notice for unsatisfactory performance or misconduct. Selected candidates must perform work assigned by the Principal, College of Horticulture, SDAU, Jagudan. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview at their own cost and remain present at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University (SDAU).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for SDAU Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for SDAU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026 at 09:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for SDAU JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Agri.) or B.Sc. (Horti.) degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the SDAU Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed pay of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SDAU JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview taking place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the College of Horticulture, S. D. Agricultural University, Jagudan-384 460 (Dist. Mehsana).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job position?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and contractual for 11 months or up to the completion of project work, whichever is early.
